CustomField.description: Use in SMS Template as concatenated field
CustomField.formula: TEXT(DATEVALUE(EYI_Site_Visit_Date__c)) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(EYI_Address__Street__s)), ", " & EYI_Address__Street__s, "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK( EYI_Address__City__s )), ", " & EYI_Address__City__s, "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK( EYI_Address__PostalCode__s )), ", " & EYI_Address__PostalCode__s, "")
CustomField.label: Site Visit and Project Address
